mapper.sql: WITH bridge_latest AS ( SELECT r.*,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY qlid ORDER BY sjtbsj DESC NULLS LAST, xgsj DESC NULLS LAST,sczt DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC) AS source_rank FROM dwd_ql_js_ql_inc r WHERE nullif(trim(qlid),'') IS NOT NULL ), bridge_candidates AS ( SELECT * FROM bridge_latest WHERE source_rank=1 AND (sczt=0 OR sczt IS NULL) AND sscsdm LIKE '32%' ), point_latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(sscsdm,bsm) * FROM dwd_ql_jc_jcd_inc r WHERE nullif(trim(bsm),'') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sscsdm,bsm,sjtbsj DESC NULLS LAST,(sjtbzt='D') DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC ), point_source AS ( SELECT * FROM point_latest WHERE coalesce(sjtbzt,'')!='D' AND (jclx=70 OR jclx IS NULL) ), bridge_keys AS ( SELECT sscsdm,qlid AS bridge_key,qlid AS bridge_id FROM bridge_candidates UNION SELECT sscsdm,qlbh AS bridge_key,qlid AS bridge_id FROM bridge_candidates WHERE nullif(trim(qlbh),'') IS NOT NULL ), point_candidates AS ( SELECT p.*,k.bridge_id,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.sscsdm,p.bsm) AS matches FROM point_source p JOIN bridge_keys k ON ARRAY[k.sscsdm,k.bridge_key]::text[]=ARRAY[p.sscsdm,p.ssbm]::text[] ), point_bridge AS ( SELECT * FROM point_candidates WHERE matches=1 ), device_latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON(sscsdm,bsm) * FROM dwd_ql_jc_jcsb_inc r WHERE nullif(trim(bsm),'') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sscsdm,bsm,sjtbsj DESC NULLS LAST,(sjtbzt='D') DESC NULLS LAST,cjsj DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC ), device_source AS ( SELECT * FROM device_latest WHERE coalesce(sjtbzt,'')!='D' ), device_bridges AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT DISTINCT p.bridge_id FROM point_bridge p JOIN device_source d ON ARRAY[d.sscsdm,d.dwbsm]::text[]=ARRAY[p.sscsdm,p.bsm]::text[] ), bridge_active AS ( SELECT b.* FROM bridge_candidates b JOIN device_bridges d ON d.bridge_id=b.qlid ), bridge_base AS ( SELECT b.*,d.bridge_id IS NOT NULL AS has_monitoring_devices, CASE WHEN b.yhlb=1 THEN 'I' WHEN b.yhlb BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 'II_V' ELSE 'unknown' END AS assessment_category, CASE WHEN nullif(trim(b.qlwhzk),'') IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN trim(b.qlwhzk) NOT IN('1','2','3','4','5','6','7') THEN 'invalid' WHEN b.yhlb IS NULL OR b.yhlb NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'unclassified' WHEN (b.yhlb=1 AND trim(b.qlwhzk) IN('3','4','5','6','7')) OR (b.yhlb BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND trim(b.qlwhzk) IN('1','2')) THEN 'conflict' ELSE trim(b.qlwhzk) END AS condition_grade_bucket, CASE WHEN nullif(trim(b.qljgzk),'') IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN trim(b.qljgzk) NOT IN('1','2','3','4','5','6','7') THEN 'invalid' WHEN b.yhlb IS NULL OR b.yhlb NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'unclassified' WHEN (b.yhlb=1 AND trim(b.qljgzk) IN('3','4','5','6','7')) OR (b.yhlb BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND trim(b.qljgzk) IN('1','2')) THEN 'conflict' ELSE trim(b.qljgzk) END AS structure_grade_bucket, CASE WHEN b.jkjclx IS NULL AND d.bridge_id IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE b.jkjclx END AS effective_monitoring_type FROM bridge_active b LEFT JOIN device_bridges d ON d.bridge_id=b.qlid )

b.qlid AS id,b.qlbh AS code,b.qlmc AS name,b.sscsdm AS city_code, coalesce((SELECT max(name) FROM area a WHERE a.id=b.sscsdm),b.sscsdm) AS city, b.jglx AS type,b.kjfl AS span_type,b.jkjclx AS monitoring_type,b.szdlmc AS road, b.qlzc::float8 AS length,b.qlzk::float8 AS width,b.jd::float8 AS longitude,b.wd::float8 AS latitude, b.qljgzk AS technical_grade,b.jcrq::text AS inspection_date,b.jgny AS completed_date, b.gldw AS manager,b.yhdw AS maintainer,b.sjtbsj AS source_updated_at, b.qlwhzk AS condition_grade,b.qljgzk AS structure_grade,b.yhlb AS maintenance_category,b.qlzt AS bridge_status, b.sfyj AS transferred,b.sfcc AS demolished,b.cczt AS demolition_status,b.sfyjjcxt AS monitoring_system_built, b.effective_monitoring_type,b.has_monitoring_devices,nullif(trim(b.jcbg),'') IS NOT NULL AS inspection_report_present, b.sfstql AS special_bridge,b.stql AS special_types_raw,b.sfdzd AS single_column_pier

where.if: AND (position(lower(#{filter.q}) in lower(coalesce(b.qlmc,'')))>0 OR position(lower(#{filter.q}) in lower(coalesce(b.qlbh,'')))>0)
AND (CASE WHEN b.jglx BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN b.jglx ELSE 99 END)=#{filter.type}

choose.when: AND (b.effective_monitoring_type IS NULL OR b.effective_monitoring_type NOT IN(1,2))

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM bridge_base b
ORDER BY b.sscsdm,b.qlmc,b.qlid

SELECT
FROM bridge_base b WHERE b.qlid=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bridge_base WHERE qlid=#{id})
SELECT b.sscsdm AS code,coalesce((SELECT max(name) FROM area a WHERE a.id=b.sscsdm),b.sscsdm) AS label,count(*) AS count FROM bridge_active b GROUP BY b.sscsdm ORDER BY count(*) DESC,b.sscsdm

SELECT b.xzqhdm AS district_code,b.qlfl AS bridge_class,b.ytfl AS use_class,b.dldj AS road_grade,b.yhdj AS maintenance_level, b.qlks AS span_count,b.kjzh AS span_arrangement,b.dkzdkj AS max_span,b.qmmj AS deck_area,b.cllx AS material,b.zlxs AS main_girder, b.hzdj AS load_grade,b.shejhz AS design_load,b.sjhz AS actual_load,b.xzbz AS load_limit,b.sfdzd AS single_column_pier,b.dzdsl AS single_column_pier_count, b.jsdw AS construction_unit,b.sjdw AS design_unit,b.jldw AS supervision_unit,b.sgdw AS contractor,b.qlgk AS overview, b.jzndzdlx AS age_band,b.gkjhdzxny::text AS reconstruction_date,b.zzj AS cost_ten_thousand,b.dabh AS archive_code,b.tzqk AS drawing_status,b.dzda AS electronic_archive,b.sjtbsj AS source_updated_at FROM bridge_active b WHERE b.qlid=#{id}

WITH bridge_active AS ( SELECT * FROM dwd_ql_js_ql_inc r WHERE qlid=#{id} ORDER BY sjtbsj DESC NULLS LAST,xgsj DESC NULLS LAST,sczt DESC NULLS LAST,to_jsonb(r)::text DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT b.xzqhdm AS district_code,b.qlfl AS bridge_class,b.ytfl AS use_class,b.dldj AS road_grade,b.yhdj AS maintenance_level, b.qlks AS span_count,b.kjzh AS span_arrangement,b.dkzdkj AS max_span,b.qmmj AS deck_area,b.cllx AS material,b.zlxs AS main_girder, b.hzdj AS load_grade,b.shejhz AS design_load,b.sjhz AS actual_load,b.xzbz AS load_limit,b.sfdzd AS single_column_pier,b.dzdsl AS single_column_pier_count, b.jsdw AS construction_unit,b.sjdw AS design_unit,b.jldw AS supervision_unit,b.sgdw AS contractor,b.qlgk AS overview, b.jzndzdlx AS age_band,b.gkjhdzxny::text AS reconstruction_date,b.zzj AS cost_ten_thousand,b.dabh AS archive_code,b.tzqk AS drawing_status,b.dzda AS electronic_archive,b.sjtbsj AS source_updated_at FROM bridge_active b WHERE b.qlid=#{id} AND (b.sczt=0 OR b.sczt IS NULL) AND b.sscsdm LIKE '32%'
